dependencies.CLOCK: No lawful clock control: injected DIAGNOSTIC_RUNTIME/IDENTITY_CLOCK read private `now` (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:101,227-229); its only mutator is expireSelectedQualification (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:383), fixed to the selected B technician deadline. Advancing the clock is a new helper capability outside the released helper scope (resource identities only).
dependencies.RIGHTS: No isolated per-visit rights expiry: every provenance/evidence uses fixed preparedReaderRights until 2027-01-01 (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:58-62,335,343), the same instant as every Session expiry (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:258); even with a clock, expiry is not isolatable to A, B, one visit or the proof. Per-visit rights input is a helper capability outside scope.
dependencies.SHARED_PRIVATE_COMMISSIONER: Private A and B share commissionerB (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:277); purgeA requires commissionerA (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:423). Lawful A erasure / raw erasure / proof disposal comes only from the commissioner purge (apps/worker/src/jobs/diagnosticAccountErasure.ts:37,88,93), which would also erase private B. Separate private commissioners are a helper capability outside scope.
dependencies.ISOLATED_REPORT_ERASURE: No producer erases a report while its order survives: report erasure is scoped to the commissioner's unerased orders and the same transaction erases the order (apps/worker/src/jobs/diagnosticAccountErasure.ts:37,93). handoffs() authorizes the live B order first (apps/api/src/modules/diagnostics/infrastructure/PrismaDiagnosticContinuityProofs.ts:704), so `body.result` cannot be null with a 200 body after B report erasure.
dependencies.RAW_IMMUTABLE: Raw identity records are append-only; observation changes on unerased rows raise diagnostic_identity_record_immutable (packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261029190000_operational_reset_row_admission/migration.sql:310-331). Raw erasure happens only through commissioner purge (apps/worker/src/jobs/diagnosticAccountErasure.ts:88).
dependencies.EVIDENCE_GUARD: A disconnected retained evidence copy requires an INSERT the evidence binding guard forbids (packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261029190000_operational_reset_row_admission/migration.sql:434-467).
dependencies.STAFF_MANAGE_ACTOR: Staff grant revocation (PrismaStaffAuthority.change, apps/api/src/modules/identity/infrastructure/PrismaStaffAuthority.ts:34-53) requires a staff.manage/founder.control actor Session; the fixture's bootstrap is private and provisions diagnostics capabilities only.
dependencies.ADMIN_ACTOR: User suspension (PrismaIdentityAdminRepository.suspendUser, apps/api/src/modules/identity/infrastructure/PrismaIdentityAdminRepository.ts:12-47) requires an admin actor user_eligibility source command; the fixture provisions no admin actor.
dependencies.NULL_DISPLAY_NAME: No producer sets displayName NULL except account purge, which also removes Sessions/assignments; PrismaUserRepository.updateDisplayName accepts a string (apps/api/src/modules/identity/infrastructure/PrismaUserRepository.ts:102-105).
dependencies.BUSINESS_GRAPH: Business source membership requires dealership and dealership_member INSERTs; the restricted role has only UPDATE on dealerships and only DELETE on dealership_members (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:179-188). The original's listing.update(businessId) / dealershipMember seed and the F04 Business OWNER grant actor have no producer within the released paths.
dependencies.REVIEWER_QUALIFICATION: Reviewer qualification outlives technician qualification (apps/api/test/helpers/diagnosticPreparedReaderFixture.ts:263-266); any clock reaching the reviewer deadline also expires the selected technician, changing the technician's literal 200 body read to 403. No isolated producer.
dependencies.SESSION_EXPIRY_EQUIVALENCE: The original transition is Session expiry (expiresAt=now). Session expiry has no clock (see CLOCK) and coincides with rights expiry (see RIGHTS). The only lawful adapter is Session revocation (PrismaSessionRepository.deleteAllByUserId), a different named transition. Using it needs explicit Parent equivalence disposition.
dependencies.LATER_ARRIVAL_FENCE: A later arrival outside the cursor time fence needs a report created after the traversal fence; the fixture clock is constant and the original writes createdAt +1ms directly (see CLOCK).
